action_type_source: Shin et al., CSET 2021, Appendix A; scenario types transcribed to hai21_scenario_action_types.csv
target_ground_truth_source: HAI maintainer technical manual, aligned to CSV attack intervals
interpretation: Descriptive, action-type-stratified target localization only. Scenario action labels are post-hoc evaluation strata; they are not passed to detectors, explainers, or candidate searches. Missed detections and failed counterfactuals count as misses. No subgroup significance tests are reported because action-type strata are small and repeated seeds reuse the same attack IDs. Documented target agreement is not causal validation or proof of physical feasibility.
